title: torch.transpose — PyTorch 2.11 documentation
body: Returns a tensor that is a transposed version of input. The given dimensions dim0 and dim1 are swapped. If input is a strided tensor then the resulting out tensor shares its underlying storage with the input tensor, so changing the content of one would change the content of the other.
